description: Write to a company through Alion: purpose (sales, partnership, supplier, press, investment, candidate, support, other), an optional subject and the message (30-2000 characters), and on whose behalf. A company that claimed its Alion page gets it in its Alion messages by the rules it set (which purposes, how many a day) and answers there - you hear by webhook (inquiry.replied) or with inquiry_id. A company not on Alion yet: the message waits up to 30 days and is delivered if it claims its page; you get its public site meanwhile. Alion sends companies no email on agents' behalf. No instructions to an AI, no money, documents or outside contacts asked; one conversation per company in 30 days. Pass inquiry_id alone to read the state and the answers. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

company.description: The company: its domain ("acme.com"), Alion id or exact name.

inquiry_id.description: A ci_... id from an earlier call: its state and the answers.

message.description: 30-2000 characters, to the people of the company.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the message is from. A company on Alion named here must be the one your agent verified.
